description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Building footprints represent the Chambers Bay regional wastewater treatment plant expansion from preliminary CAD drawings. The native layer exposes polygon geometry and named attributes, including AREA, BUILDING_LETTER, NAME, LINK. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for hazard exposure studies. These are preliminary design footprints, not surveyed as-built geometry or proof that every expansion element was constructed. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. Related existing records below provide broader network or asset-location context; their scope is distinct from this resource.
